## Results and exact receivers

Main complete proof: SEMILATTICE_HEAT_ZERO.tex in this directory.

- SH1–9: complete G_L(R); fibrewise additive inverse; local multiplicative corner; universal unital support localization; exact kernel congruence and kernel-pair amplitude-difference map.
- SH6a–6c: over a field the whole multiplicative monoid is genuinely an inverse monoid. All zλ are self-inverse. Its multiplicative identity idempotent for a nonzero amplitude is hat1; for a collided supported difference it is e. Exact division law is d(d†f)=η(d)f. No claim that G_L(K[[t,z]]) itself is an inverse monoid.
- SH10–14: original module support P=eM retained as an entire join-semilattice with every R-module fibre and transport. Full G_L action adds its precise L-semimodule action on P. Both adjunctions proved, including the distinction K_regular={τ} versus amplitude reflection R.
- SH15–21a: coefficientwise integral heat over every commutative ring, exact inverse signs, time-zero identity, PDE uniqueness in Q-algebras and torsion solution object otherwise. Product and reciprocal defects are explicit; transported commutative star multiplication gives the exact isomorphism receiver.
- SH22–27: heat on the full original G_L(R[[t,z]]) and on arbitrary original fibre diagrams; all support-localization maps commute. Time-zero quotient is a nontrivial congruence with trivial external-zero ideal. Fibre over e is hat(tA), all lower labels remain.
- SH28–30a: punctured-time special fibre is L by a proved semiring pushout, and every finite time thickening localizes to L. Its spectral image is the full support stratum; it is the exact intersection of the time-zero image and punctured chart. Ordinary amplitude pushout is the zero ring.
- SH31–39: independent coefficient-label carrier G_L(R)[[t,z]]. Forward/reverse heat composite is the idempotent closure Cλ(m,n)=join_{j=0}^m λ(m−j,n+2j), with original amplitudes unchanged. Fixed support space, quotient kernel equivalence, genuine supported-zero tails, cosine even-series example, uniform global-label embedding with its actual idempotent image unit, and both universal support quotients are proved. Time-zero row is unchanged.
- SH40–41: analytic zero evaluations use the local coordinate w=z−a, preserving the exact initial value and multiplicity. Full support localization alone identifies values regardless of zero status; the kernel congruence and joint amplitude/support map recover precisely the omitted distinction.

No implication to failure of heat monotonicity or RH is asserted by this bounded calculation. Parent is deriving the original Rodgers–Tao and trajectory maps separately.

## Verification

Reproducible standard-library exact checker: SEMILATTICE_HEAT_CHECKS.py.

Static checks cover environment nesting, braces, internal references, unique equation tags, display delimiters and control characters.

Exact mathematical checks cover the full four-label Boolean lattice over F5, distributivity, local additive inverses and support projectors, all unique reflexive multiplicative inverses, 100 deterministic coefficient-support examples of both heat signs and their closure identities, every checked time-zero row, the literal z² supported-zero tail, and integral coefficient cancellation identities.

The general proofs are in the TeX; these finite checks supplement them. No rendering or compilation was performed.
